a.lede: New York joins Pennsylvania in protecting gamers' rights to own games, requiring publishers to provide an offline mode and the right to transfer games.
a.title: New York rep announces game ownership bill that would require consumer ownership rather than sale of licenses

b.lede: Representative Ritchie Torres wants the FTC to establish regulations ensuring you can play the games you've purchased.
b.title: NY congressman to introduce bill protecting video game ownership
